title: Nimbu's: Slightly Longer Swords
description: One pixel longer swords, because regular swords are short and stubby.
body:
![Nimbu](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/32ce7015222543ea15fb62d5f1c9de8148cd9a1a.png)

Adds one pixel longer swords to minecraft, because they're kinda short otherwise.
I started using this now I can't go back.

**Requires NeoForge!**

Built for 1.21.1, probably works for other versions.

Sometimes causes a visual bug with text / crash when being applied, but will work fine after.
